connector.name: TokenSaver
connector.registryDescription: Structural warm start for AI coding agents in .NET: cheap Roslyn signature maps of C#/.NET files.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the NuGet package TokenSaver.Mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the byggarepop account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TOKENSAVER_API_URL
env.description: URL of the TokenSaver reporting dashboard. Defaults to https://tokensavermcp.com.

env.name: TOKENSAVER_NO_TELEMETRY
env.description: Set to 1 to opt out of anonymous usage telemetry.
